INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

2. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.

5. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.

6. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.

7. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
